verdict.rationale: Temporal's docs explicitly promise crash-proof execution: apps resume exactly where they left off after crashes, network failures, or infrastructure outages. They also say Activity results are not repeated during Workflow replay, so workflows survive Worker restarts without losing state, and Worker Versioning (Pinned/Auto-Upgrade) addresses resuming across deploys. Community users broadly endorse the durable-execution model, though none describes a specific crash-recovery test. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of crash or deploy recovery, and detailed docs in the pack on the event-history/replay mechanics that restore state.
